_doc: Demo video as data (VIDEO-1). Each scene is a live ultrastable.io page plus one narration line. Every line must be a verbatim excerpt of its allowlisted SAFE NOW source and pass the social guard (scripts/social_lib.py); scripts/video_build.py --check enforces it and runs in checks. Built server-side by .github/workflows/demo-video.yml. Owner of the loop: marketing-manager (agents/roles/marketing-manager.md).

scenes.text: Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.
Coding agents write code. Ultrastable runs the system.
Ultrastable is an autonomous system that sets up and runs any organized effort from one idea.
That is how Ultrastable is built: multi-agent, self-referential loops, not a single code agent.
Only decisions that cannot be undone come to a person.
